title: Agent Management
summary: This module defines the core components for managing AI agents, including their lifecycle, execution, tool integration, and interaction with language models.

nodes.label: AgentMeta
nodes.title: Agent Metaclass
nodes.description: A generic metaclass that detects and applies extension fields (like 'a2a') to agent classes, enabling extended functionality.

nodes.label: Handle Reasoning
nodes.title: Agent Reasoning Handler
nodes.description: Manages the reasoning and planning process for an agent before task execution, appending the generated plan to the task description.

nodes.label: BaseConverterAdapter
nodes.title: Base Converter Adapter
nodes.description: Abstract base class for converting agent outputs into structured formats, supporting JSON and Pydantic, and enhancing system prompts.

nodes.label: LangGraphAgentAdapter
nodes.title: LangGraph Agent Adapter
nodes.description: Integrates LangGraph's ReAct agents with CrewAI, providing memory persistence, tool integration, and structured output support.

nodes.label: OpenAIAgentAdapter
nodes.title: OpenAI Agent Adapter
nodes.description: Integrates OpenAI Assistants API with CrewAI, handling tool configuration, structured output, and task execution.

nodes.label: CrewAgentExecutor
nodes.title: Crew Agent Executor
nodes.description: Manages the execution lifecycle of an agent, including prompt formatting, LLM interactions, tool execution, and feedback handling. (Deprecated)

nodes.label: ToolsHandler
nodes.title: Tool Usage Handler
nodes.description: Manages tool usage callbacks and optionally caches tool outputs for agents.

nodes.label: LiteAgent
nodes.title: Lightweight Agent
nodes.description: A simplified agent for direct message processing and tool usage, designed for interactions where a full crew is not needed. (Deprecated)

nodes.label: LLM Integration
nodes.title: LLM Integration
nodes.description: Handles interactions with various Large Language Models (LLMs) and their specific APIs.

nodes.label: A2A Core
nodes.title: Agent-to-Agent Core
nodes.description: Provides core functionalities for Agent-to-Agent communication and delegation.

nodes.label: Event System
nodes.title: Event System
nodes.description: Manages and dispatches events within the CrewAI framework, enabling logging, tracing, and inter-component communication.

nodes.label: General Utilities
nodes.title: General Utilities
nodes.description: Provides common utility functions and helper classes used across the CrewAI framework.

nodes.label: Hooks and Callbacks
nodes.title: Hooks and Callbacks
nodes.description: Manages custom hooks and callback functions that can be injected into various stages of agent and LLM operations.

nodes.label: Memory Management
nodes.title: Memory Management
nodes.description: Handles the storage, retrieval, and analysis of agent memories, enabling agents to recall past interactions and learn.

groups.label: Agent Core
groups.title: Core Agent Logic
groups.description: Components defining the fundamental structure and behavior of agents.

groups.label: Agent Adapters
groups.title: External Agent System Integration
groups.description: Adapters for integrating with different agent frameworks and managing structured output.

groups.label: Agent Execution
groups.title: Agent Execution Flow
groups.description: Manages the execution of agent tasks, including LLM interaction, tool usage, and result processing.
